name: @dotos1/mcp
description: DOTOS Angular 22 组件库（@dotos/dui、@dotos/duix、@dotos/xdraw）官方自愈 MCP Server

scripts.clean: node -e "import('node:fs').then(fs => { fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.rmSync('dist-test', { recursive: true, force: true }); })"
scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node -e "import('node:fs').then(fs => fs.chmodSync('dist/cli.js', 0o755))"
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test dist-test/**/*.test.js && node -e "import('node:fs').then(fs => fs.rmSync('dist-test', { recursive: true, force: true }))"
